items.claim: Tran Gore has a go-to move of timing a counter into a front choke.
items.quote: He could time a good counter into a front choke. It's possible, right? That's like his go-to move.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando got grappled by Caesar Almeida during their Contender Series fight.
items.quote: the bad thing about that fight on the Fernando side was that he got grappled by Caesar Almeida at times in that fight

items.claim: Lucas Fernando has moved up to the 205-pound division.
Lucas Fernando is the much better striker compared to Rafael Tobias.
items.quote: Fernando is the much better striker here.

items.claim: Rafael Tobias is the much better grappler compared to Lucas Fernando.
items.quote: Tobias is the much better grappler in my opinion.

items.claim: Rafael Tobias got exposed in his last fight and struggles if he cannot secure top position.
items.quote: Tobias kind of got exposed in his last fight and doesn't really look that high level if he can't get top position

items.claim: Neil Magny has the most fights out of any fighter on the entire fight card with a record of 31 wins and 14 losses.
items.quote: Magny coming into this fight 31 wins 14 losses absolute veteran record. I'm pretty sure that's the most fights out of any fighter on the entire fight card.
